We lift Jentech’s 2026-28E EPS by 15-39% to reflect a more solid sales/ASP growth,
driven by new platform launches and an even better margin expansion pace. Our 2026-
28 EPS forecasts are 13-42% above consensus. We expect to see sales/EPS
upward revision from the Street after Aug sales release. We raise our PO to NT$6,800
(30x 2H27-1H28E EPS) from NT$4,000 (25x 2H27-1H28E EPS), with a higher P/E
multiple and an unchanged valuation base. We now use 30x for more solid sales/EPS
growth (86%/104% sales/EPS CAGR in 2026-28) with higher margins. The 30x multiple
is also similar to what we set for component sub-sector leaders like Delta & King Slide.
We reiterate Buy on Jentech as the top semi packaging-level cooling component maker.

我們上修健策2026/27 年獲利15%/23%，主要考量到高階均熱片需求強勁，
且出貨量明顯優於預期，並帶動其均熱片業務的營收比重大幅提升，毛利率
優化明確；此外，除了明年的AMD 400 系列採用兩件式均熱片外，AWS
T4 晶片的規格可能將大幅提升，帶動均熱片單價再增加；另外，Rubin 目前
有在進行一次測試，可能會在未來有所進展。我們認為健策長期趨勢仍未改
變，並維持其龍頭地位，維持健策買進評等，目標價上修至6,725 元，基於
2027 年預估每股盈餘、45 倍本益比評價(前次採用2027 年x40 倍本益比)。

維持「增加持股」評等，目標價由 4,840 元上調至 7,365 元 (40x 2027-28
年平均EPS)，反映利潤率擴張，使2026-28年EPS CAGR達83%。

EPS by 3% and 9% to NT$129 and NT$207, respectively, to factor in a stronger
content growth GPU customers. Hence, our new Dec-27 PT is now at NT
$6,200, based on an unchanged 30x 2028E P/E, which is largely in line with
Jentech’s 3yr avg P/E when the AI server boom started.

NT$5,650, based on an unchanged 30x 2028E P/E, which is largely in line with

We reiterate our Buy (1) call with an unchanged
12M TP of TWD6,770, still based on a target PER of 73x (vs. its past-3-
year PER range of 17-62x) applied to our 1-year forward EPS forecast. We
believe our target valuation is fair, given Jentech’s strong earnings visibility
and leading position in chip-level thermal solutions, which we believe
warrant a re-rating. Downside risks: weaker-than-expected global AI server
demand; slower-than-expected thermal spec upgrades.

We initiate Jentech at Buy with PO of NT$4,655 (implies 36% upside potential), based
on 25x 2H27-1H28E EPS. We like Jentech as: (1) a key/major packaging-level cooling
component (heat spreader, stiffener) maker; and (2) an enabler of the most-advanced
microchannel lid (MCL) liquid cooling design, driving 58%/82% sales/EPS CAGR in 2025-

in 2025-27 (BofAe: NT$0.9-1.2bn) for Taiwan capacity expansion.

We raise our earnings forecasts by 15.7%/15.5% for 2026/27F, factoring in higher
integrated heat spreader (IHS) ASP mainly from a merchant GPU’s ramp-up this year. We
reiterate our Buy rating and raise TP to TWD3,970, on 42x 2027F EPS of TWD94.45 (was
TWD3,680 on 45x 2027F EPS of TWD81.75, the lower P/E is to discount potential Kyber
rack delivery challenges). As highlighted in our initiation report and our latest Asia AI
Thermal Anchor Report , we believe Jentech’s leading position in IHS will underpin its
strong growth from AI chip boom and performance upgrade over 2026-27F. Microchannel
lids (MCL) appears to be a story to materialize in 2027-28F at the earliest, but if the
industry could succeed in overcoming the technological and supply-chain flow challenges
by late 2026F, MCLs could become strong earnings drivers for Jentech in 2H27-2028F.
The stock now trades at 31x 2027F EPS.

We initiate coverage of Jentech at OW with a Dec-26 PT of NT$3,650 (based on
27x 2027E P/E, largely in line with its 5-yr average P/E). Jentech is the largest
packaging-level cooling component maker worldwide, with leading production
capabilities across heat spreader products (including stiffener and all kinds of lids).
We expect the company to grow its EPS at an ~80% CAGR from 2024-2027E,
driven by the solid spec upgrade to micro-channel lid (MCL) with significant
content growth thanks to the greater thermal design power (TDP) of AI GPUs &
ASICs, along with additional heat spreader adoption in next-gen AI server
systems. In addition, the company is reinforcing its product portfolio with new
offerings in cold plates and CPU server sockets for its chip customers. We believe
Jentech's technology leadership in the structural cooling upgrade trend and its new
TAM expansion will continue to support its superior earnings power in the long
term. Hence, Jentech is our top pick in the liquid cooling space.
